title: Deterministic Policy Engine
objective: Compile human-readable policy into typed constraints and a fully explainable Effective Policy.

stories.title: Policy schema and scopes
stories.outcome: Define global, machine, provider, project, artifact-type, session/pin scopes and versioned policy schema.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown policy keys fail validation rather than being ignored.
Policies are data, not executable code.

stories.title: Constraint resolver
stories.outcome: Implement constitutional precedence and monotonic authority resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Safety invariants cannot be overridden by configuration.
More specific user policy cannot exceed artifact/provider/trust ceilings.
verification: Exhaustive precedence matrix and fuzz/property tests.

stories.title: Policy explanation graph
stories.outcome: Return a trace showing every rule/evidence item that contributed to the final result.
acceptance_criteria: Suppressed higher-authority requests explain exactly which ceiling won.

stories.title: Budgets, retention, pinning
stories.outcome: Implement total/provider/project budgets, age/count retention, and explicit pin/protect semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Budget pressure chooses only artifacts already eligible under safety/lifecycle rules.
